

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let mut rounds = 0;



'forever: 




loop {
    

rounds = rounds + 1;




if rounds < 2 { continue 'forever; }




break 'forever;



}







let mut countdown = 2;



'condition: 


while countdown > 0 {
    

countdown = countdown - 1;




continue 'condition;



}









let mut numbers = vec![1, 2].into_iter();



'binding: 

while let Some(number) = numbers.next() {
    

print!("bound {}", number);




if number == 1 { continue 'binding; }




break 'binding;



}









'traverse: 



for value in 0..3 {
    

if value == 0 { continue 'traverse; }




print!("item {}", value);




break 'traverse;



}






    
}
